concern: She feels overwhelmed by many serious issues (sexual abuse history, breast cancer, lifelong insomnia, depression, new anxiety, low self-esteem), has never had counseling, and worries she has too many issues to address.
first_advice: "I would encourage you to take the next step and reach out to a professional"
acknowledged_before_advice: Only factual reassurance and normalization ("there are never too many concerns," "most people... have more than one issue") followed by an explanation of how counseling works. label: premature
